title: Sedici Bella Silver

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Tailored for classic roadsters and urban cruising, the Bell Sedici Bella Silver is engineered for warm-weather riding with featherweight crown comfort. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell tips the scales at a featherweight 1262g, channeling boundary-layer airflow to maintain a ~98 dB acoustic cabin profile while meeting DOT, ECE 22.05 impact standards. The interior features a plush, moisture-wicking crown liner shaped for Round Oval head shapes, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for effortless warm-weather riding.

product_details.description: Sedici Bella open face with shield.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Optimized for Round Oval head shapes with pressure-relief temple channels and contoured removable cheek pads.

technical_analysis: Features 3K Carbon Fiber shell featuring Flex Impact Liner with progressive three-layer density rotational energy management paired with Panovision Class-1 optics visor with extended lateral field of view. The interior utilizes Virus CoolJade anti-bacterial lining paired with Magnefusion magnetic removable cheek pads with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Bell Sedici Bella Silver: combining United States 🇺🇸 craftsmanship with Panovision Class-1 optics visor with extended lateral field of view and Virus CoolJade anti-bacterial lining paired with Magnefusion magnetic removable cheek pads. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

introduction: Positioned in Bell's Open Face lineup, the Sedici Bella Silver brings American engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for a Round Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The Bell Sedici Bella Silver represents Bell's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~98 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Open Face helmet tailored to a Round Oval head shape, the Bell Sedici Bella Silver delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
